metadata.title: Stellar masses and ages in Gaia Data Release 4 from the Final Luminosity Age Mass Estimator algorithm

notes: No star meets the Galactic-unbound criteria. The high-velocity sample discussed in Sect. 6.1 (T:p10-b13) and listed in Table C.1 (T:p17-b0) is described as high-velocity/metal-poor, with proposed ejection origins, but the paper does not state that any member is unbound from the Milky Way or satisfies an explicit unbound criterion; labels and ejection mechanisms alone do not establish candidacy. The other studied samples are not Galactic-unbound candidates.
